name: AdEMAMix
description: AdEMAMix combines fast and slow gradient EMAs with Adam-style variance scaling. foreach, fused, and capturable are not claimed; DDP/FSDP/ZeRO compatibility matches a plain torch optimizer step on local parameters.

parameters.backend_options: forwarded to native torch.optim.AdEMAMix when available; fallback rejects unsupported options

papers.title: The AdEMAMix Optimizer: Better, Faster, Older

examples.title: Minimize a scalar objective with AdEMAMix
examples.code:
import torch
from topologies.implementations.optimizers.ademamix import ademamix

parameter = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(3.0))
optimizer = ademamix([parameter], lr=0.05)
for _ in range(20):
    optimizer.zero_grad()
    (parameter - 1).square().backward()
    optimizer.step()
